<details>
<summary><strong>💭 Thinking Process</strong></summary>

> The project is a landing page for Debite, a fintech payment theme.
>
> Several responsive issues were identified. Font paths appear broken. The navbar toggles between display:none and display:block, which disrupts flex layout. Hero images may overflow on mobile. Feature boxes rely on absolute positioning that behaves poorly on tablets. Map images use fixed widths that could overflow smaller screens.
>
> Additional responsive gaps were found. Services columns need flex-wrap on tablets. Testimonials use four columns with partial mobile handling. The footer CTA card relies on absolute positioning with complex breakpoints. The footer grid collapses from four columns to two on small screens without proper tablet handling. Semantic HTML improvements and consistent responsive classes are also needed.
>
> Specific fixes are planned. Hero and map images will use max-width utilities to prevent overflow. Services, section four, and the footer CTA will stack vertically on mobile and tablet. The phone number will hide or abbreviate on very small screens. The mobile navigation will switch to flex display when active, and the close button will be hidden on desktop while remaining visible on mobile. Horizontal scrolling will be prevented by adding overflow-x hidden to the body.

</details>

## 🤖 Assistant #75 (Agent)

_2026-06-27 17:55:27Z_

I've reviewed the full **Debite** landing page and made it responsive across mobile, tablet, and desktop. Here's what changed:

### Global fixes
- Prevented horizontal scrolling (`overflow-x: hidden`)
- All images scale with `max-width: 100%`
- Added a consistent `.container` (max-width 1280px with adaptive padding)
- Headings use fluid `clamp()` sizing instead of fixed pixel sizes

### Navigation (mobile & tablet)
- Slide-in menu below **1024px** with overlay backdrop
- Body scroll locks when the menu is open
- Close on overlay click, **Escape** key, or window resize
- Dropdowns work on tap on mobile (hover on desktop)
- Phone number text hides on very small screens; icon stays visible

### Section-by-section
| Section | Responsive behavior |
|--------|---------------------|
| **Hero** | Stacks vertically on tablet/mobile; fluid headline |
| **Feature boxes** | Stack below 1024px (no more absolute overlap) |
| **Map / stats** | Column layout on tablet; stats scale with `clamp()` |
| **Services** | 1 col → 2 col (640px+) → 3 col (1024px+) |
| **Invoice / phone** | Stacks on tablet; phone images scale proportionally |
| **Stats row** | 2×2 grid on mobile, row on desktop |
| **Testimonials** | 1 → 2 → 4 columns by breakpoint |
| **Footer CTA** | Card image stacks below text on mobile/tablet |
| **Footer grid** | 1 → 2 → 4 columns |

### Files updated
- `style.css` — responsive rules, nav, layout utilities
- `index.html` — semantic `<nav>`, cleaner classes, accessible labels
- `script.js` — improved mobile menu behavior

Open `index.html` in your browser and resize the window (or use DevTools device mode) to check:
- **320px** — small phones  
- **768px** — tablets  
- **1024px+** — desktop  

If anything still looks off on a specific screen size, tell me which section and width and I can fine-tune it.

  "contents": "const navbar = document.getElementById(\"navbar\");\nconst header = document.getElementById(\"btn\");\nconst closeBtn = document.getElementById(\"close\");\nconst overlay = document.getElementById(\"nav-overlay\");\nconst dropdowns = document.querySelectorAll(\".dropdown\");\n\nfunction openNav() {\n  navbar?.classList.add(\"active\");\n  overlay?.classList.add(\"active\");\n  document.body.classList.add(\"nav-open\");\n}\n\nfunction closeNav() {\n  navbar?.classList.remove(\"active\");\n  overlay?.classList.remove(\"active\");\n  document.body.classList.remove(\"nav-open\");\n  dropdowns.forEach((dropdown) => dropdown.classList.remove(\"open\"));\n}\n\nif (header) {\n  header.addEventListener(\"click\", (e) => {\n    e.preventDefault();\n    openNav();\n  });\n}\n\nif (closeBtn) {\n  closeBtn.addEventListener(\"click\", closeNav);\n}\n\nif (overlay) {\n  overlay.addEventListener(\"click\", closeNav);\n}\n\ndropdowns.forEach((dropdown) => {\n  const link = dropdown.querySelector(\"a\");\n  if (!link) return;\n\n  link.addEventListener(\"click\", (e) => {\n    if (window.innerWidth > 1023) return;\n    e.preventDefault();\n    dropdown.classList.toggle(\"open\");\n  });\n});\n\nwindow.addEventListener(\"resize\", () => {\n  if (window.innerWidth > 1023) {\n    closeNav();\n  }\n});\n\ndocument.addEventListener(\"keydown\", (e) => {\n  if (e.key === \"Escape\") {\n    closeNav();\n  }\n});\n",

- Background gradient is **top-center**; particle overlay uses **`background-size: cover`** and slightly higher opacity so it reads better on all widths.

- Built a **composite visual**: `robo.png` (hand) + `card.png` (cards) in one container.
- Cards are **absolutely positioned on the hand** with percentage-based `top` / `width`, so they **scale together** on every screen.
- On **desktop**: text left, hand+cards on the right.
- On **mobile/tablet**: stacked, but cards still sit on the hands.
